title: Crypto
description: Cryptocurrency market data including price, trading volume, market capitalization, supply metrics, price history, and market ranking. Used for crypto exchanges, portfolio trackers, and financial applications.

id.description: Unique identifier for the cryptocurrency record

symbol.description: Cryptocurrency ticker symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH, ADA)

name.description: Full name of the cryptocurrency (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum, Cardano)

price.description: Current market price per unit in USD

change_24h.description: Price change percentage over the last 24 hours

volume_24h.description: Trading volume in the last 24 hours

circulating_supply.description: Number of coins currently in circulation

total_supply.description: Total number of coins that will ever exist (if capped) or current total supply

high_24h.description: Highest price reached in the last 24 hours

low_24h.description: Lowest price reached in the last 24 hours

ath_date.description: Date when the all-time high price was reached

rank.description: Market capitalization ranking among all cryptocurrencies

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this market data was recorded
